note: Fantasy and science fiction. Every place is an original design, not from any game, anime, film or franchise, and built to be physically plausible: real materials, real scale, a floor that bears weight. Screens, holograms and signs stay blank colour fields; any glow (neon, crystals, lamps) sits at the edges, never in the empty centre about four metres from the camera. No creatures, robots, craft insignia or figures.
